description: 54.61 cm (21.5-inch) VA panel of L22e-30 with 3-side near-edgeless design delivers quality visuals as well as modern look. L22e-30 adopted stylish sculpted stand with phone holder and cable management groove. Users can easily get immersed in entertainment with 75Hz refresh rate and free-sync while Low Blue Light certified eyecare technology reduces eye fatigue even after long hours. With Artery software loaded, users can adjust monitor setting with convenient interface. * This Lenovo 66CBKCC1US Monitor image is for illustration purpose only. Actual image may vary. FEATURES OF LENOVO L22e-30 MONITOR Minimalist design, understated flair With its 3-side NearEdgeless head design, Lenovo L22e-30’s elegant, minimal form looks good in any home with its 21.5-inch VA panel screen. It makes watching movies or streaming TV shows pure pleasure without bulky bezels. That screen gives a sharp view of small details when studying, editing videos or reading documents. With a wedge stand engineered for elegance, stability and convenience because it tidies cables behind its neck and has an integrated phone holder. * This Lenovo 66CBKCC1US Monitor image is for illustration purpose only.
